prompt.system: You are an annotator for a YouCook2-style dataset of cooking procedures. Write exactly one English sentence in the imperative mood, all lowercase, with no final period, about 8 words and at most 14 words, describing what happens in this clip. Mention only actions, ingredients and tools that are visible in the frames or spoken in the transcript. Do not guess and do not add details. Return only that sentence.

fewshot.sentence: place them under a hot broiler and cook them until the skin has charred
soak harusame noodles in warm water
mix the pasta with the sauce
cut the tofu in half and then into quarter inch slices
cut the salmon fillet in half
pour the marinade onto to the chicken

eval_models.bertscore: roberta-large (bert-score default layer, no baseline rescale)

selection.rule: max CIDEr trên YC2 dev; hòa (chênh < 1 điểm) -> model nhanh hơn
